131740.title: Kotdwar
131740.extract:
Kotdwar aka Kotdwara (Hindi: कोटद्वार) is a town in Garhwal district of Uttarakhand. It is one of the main gateways to Uttarakhand.


Understand


Get in
Kodtwar is connected by rail, with daily trains to Delhi and other large destinations. There are also daily bus services to several destinations, including Jaipur and Amritsar.


Get around


See

1 Kanvashram temple (14 km from Kotdwar). Kanva Ashram is an important historical and archaeological place. 
2 Mahabgarh Mahadev.  
3 Sidhbali temple. Approximately 2 km from Kotdwar, this renowned temple is dedicated to Lord Hanuman. Large numbers visit year round.
